name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Houthi missiles at Riyadh 10–11 Nov after an Aramco building was hit on 8 Nov; Israeli strike kills two in Gaza
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on 10 and 11 Nov and drones aimed at Mecca and the south; the Houthis denied targeting Mecca and claimed an attack on a Yanbu pumping station, which Saudi Arabia has not confirmed (Reuters via Al-Monitor). An Aramco building in Riyadh was damaged in a Houthi attack on 8 Nov (SCMP). In Gaza, an Israeli drone strike killed two people in Jabaliya on 14 Nov; the Israeli military said it struck two Hamas militants (AP). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and the Palestinian territories should follow FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice. Flights in the region may be disrupted or suspended during missile alerts.
rubric_hit: Alert: major cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front (missiles at Riyadh 10–11 Nov)

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
